note: The protocol revision the probe offers in its initialize request. A server answers with the revision it speaks, and the probe prints both. Check the current revision in the Model Context Protocol specification before relying on this value.

protocol_version.note: 2025-11-25 is the newest handshake-based (initialize) revision. The current revision is 2026-07-28, which drops the initialize handshake (per-request _meta version, server/discover), so this probe, which sends initialize, offers 2025-11-25.
